exchange_rates.note: LKR per 1 unit of foreign currency, from the LKR base. Converted prices are rounded to the nearest 5 LKR.

price_verification: Every SOURCE row was priced from a page that was actually downloaded (JSON-LD offers, product:price meta, Shopify products.json, or a BigCommerce inline variant payload). No search-engine snippet was used.

products.name: KONG Classic Natural Rubber Dog Toy
products.description: The classic KONG shape in red natural rubber, with an uneven surface for a rolling bounce and a hollow middle that can be filled with kibble or a little peanut butter. Sold from extra small up to extra extra large, shown here in the smallest size.
products.image_alt: Red KONG Classic natural rubber dog toy
products.notes: Variant priced: XSmall (red natural rubber), sku T4, UPC 035585125008. Other sizes T2 11.99, T3 8.49, T1 13.99, KXL 19.99, KK 25.99.

products.name: Chuckit! Ultra Ball Dog Toy
products.description: A fetch ball with an extra thick rubber core that floats, so it works in the water as well as on land. The bright orange and blue colour is easier to spot if the ball ends up in long grass. Shown in the medium single pack.
products.image_alt: Orange and blue Chuckit Ultra Ball, medium
products.image_source_name: Petmate (official Chuckit! and JW Pet distributor store)
products.notes: Variant priced: ORANGE/BLUE / MEDIUM 1-PK, sku 170015. chuckit.com and jwpet.com are TLS-dead redirects to petmate.com, which owns both brands. There is no plain 'Ultra Ball' listing - the rest of the range is launcher bundles.

products.name: Nylabone DuraChew Bone Chew Toy, Original
products.description: A nylon bone chew from the DuraChew line, made for dogs that chew hard. The original flavour is offered in a regular size for smaller breeds and a wolf size for medium breeds and large puppies, made in the United States.
products.image_alt: Nylabone DuraChew bone chew toy, original flavour
products.notes: Variant priced: Regular (4 1/2 in, up to 25 lb breeds), sku 17266. Wolf size is sku 17267 at 13.49 CAD. nylabone.com is a where-to-buy site with no products and no prices (216 /products/ sitemap URLs are all taxonomy pages), so every DuraChew price must come from a retailer. SOFT IMAGE: this retailer only publishes 600x600 / 26 KB.

products.name: Outward Hound Hide A Squirrel Plush Puzzle Toy
products.description: A soft plush tree trunk that three squeaky animals tuck inside for a hide and seek game, and that doubles as a fetch toy once they are pulled back out. Four sizes are made, and the character can be a squirrel, bird, bee or hedgehog.
products.image_alt: Outward Hound Hide A Squirrel plush puzzle toy
products.notes: KEPT INSTEAD OF THE APPROVED SUBSTITUTE. Outward Hound publishes sku/upc/mpn/gtin as null for this product and only a $7.50-$16.50 range with no per-size mapping; the stored price is the lowest published variant price (smallest size). The approved substitute Hide A Raccoon Plush (70498) turned out to be $15.00 and instock:false, and Taco 70473, Llama 70471 and Surf Van 70472 are all instock:false, so this is the only in-stock Hide A puzzle. PAWORA-INTERNAL SKU: the brand publishes none, and the import tool requires a SKU to upsert on. The page itself reports instock:true, purchasable:true.

products.name: KONG Wubba Tug and Fetch Dog Toy
products.description: A soft plush body with a reinforced nylon outer and long floppy tails for tug, shake and fetch games. The tails make it easy to grip and the middle squeaks. Offered in small, large and extra large, shown here in the small size.
products.image_alt: KONG Wubba plush tug and fetch dog toy
products.notes: Variant priced: Small, sku WB3, UPC 035585800028. Large WB1 12.99 and XLarge WBX 17.99 are also published. /kong-wubba-classic/ is 404; the slug is /wubba/.

products.name: JW Pet Hol-ee Roller Dog Toy
products.description: A soft, stretchy natural rubber roller with an open middle that can be filled with treats, kibble, small toys or ice. Dogs work the pieces out from different angles, and the rubber is described as gentle on gums. Shown in the jumbo size, blue.
products.image_alt: Blue JW Pet Hol-ee Roller, jumbo
products.notes: Variant priced: HOL-EE ROLLER / JUMBO, sku 43113, and the image filename matches the priced sku exactly. Petmate also sells a rebranded 'chuckit-hol-ee-roller' - deliberately avoided. Mini 43109 9.99, Small 43110 11.99, Medium 43111 12.99, Large 43112 14.99 also published.

products.name: Nina Ottosson Dog Brick Treat Puzzle Toy
products.description: A level two treat puzzle from the Nina Ottosson line, made of tough removable plastic and free of BPA, PVC and phthalates. It has three treat hiding compartments: two under flip lids, one that slides out, and hollow brick shapes that lift away.
products.image_alt: Nina Ottosson Dog Brick treat puzzle, blue
products.image_source_name: Outward Hound official store (Nina Ottosson brand page)
products.notes: Variant priced: Blue, sku 67333, UPC 700603673334. ninaottosson.com is a DNS failure, so the price comes from Outward Hound, the official distributor of the Nina Ottosson line. image_source_url corrected to the real product page after the research agent returned a relative placeholder.

products.name: Hyper Pet Tough Plush Tiger Toy with Squeakers
products.description: A plush tiger with double layer construction and edge binding, extra dense stuffing and two squeakers inside. It is sold as a durable soft toy for fetch and carry games, from a brand that makes dog toys for the US market.
products.image_alt: Hyper Pet tough plush tiger toy with squeakers
products.notes: SUBSTITUTE for 'Frisco Plush Squeaking Toy' - Frisco is a Target house brand, 403 on every path and no third party stocks it. Approved by Ashan 2026-09-27.

products.name: Catit Senses Play Circuit Track Toy
products.description: Eight snap together track sections and one circuit ball that runs a closed loop at floor level, so a cat can bat the ball and watch it travel. The layout can be rearranged into more than a hundred configurations and clips onto older Senses pieces.
products.image_alt: Catit Senses Play Circuit track set with ball
products.notes: Variant priced: Play (8 piece green circuit plus ball), sku 43154. Wave 43155 is GBP 16.00 and Super 43156 is GBP 23.00. catit.com publishes no prices at all, so the brand's own UK store is the source. The '2.0' appears only in body copy.

products.name: PAWORA Interactive Paw Puzzle Toy
products.description: Our own puzzle toy for keeping a dog occupied, with a paw shaped lid that lifts away to reveal treat compartments underneath. The base is wipe clean and the whole thing is sized for small to medium dogs.
products.notes: Fictional PAWORA house product kept deliberately at Ashan's instruction 2026-09-27. Demo price, no source URL, placeholder image.
